title: A quadrilateral meeting involving the Islamic Republic of Iran, Pakistan, Turkey, and Saudi Arabia began in Tehran moments ago.
text:
A quadrilateral meeting involving the Islamic Republic of Iran, Pakistan, Turkey, and Saudi Arabia began in Tehran moments ago."

""

"🔹 The meeting was convened at Pakistan’s proposal, with the support and cooperation of the Islamic Republic of Iran."

"🔹 Major General Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council of Iran, is hosting the meeting. The other three countries are represented by Asim Munir, Chief of Army Staff of Pakistan; Khalid bin Salman, Minister of Defense of Saudi Arabia; and Ibrahim Kalın, head of Turkey’s intelligence agency."

"🔹 Key topics for discussion include regional security, the consequences of military aggression and the continuation of such acts, and providing aid to the oppressed peoples of Palestine and Lebanon.
